method.suppliers: every approved supplier (quality_approved / released_for_use) for the material
method.quantity: max(60 days of consumption, ROP - released + daily x lead), need-by = projected stockout date (cover_projection)

policies.anchor_target: open, counter twice at the low end of the supplier's synthetic price band, accept
policies.expedite_if_late: open; if lead time misses need-by ask to expedite; one price counter; accept
policies.llm_negotiator: Super-VL (doer) driving message_supplier / accept_offer with the negotiator instructions (max 8 steps)

method.win: landed USD/unit <= midpoint of list and floor (landed) AND arrival <= need-by AND 0 policy violations (core negotiationOutcome)
